description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv. 
 
 We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
 
 
 Job Title 
Software Development Engineering - SDET 
 
 About Your Role 
 At Clover, we are accelerating the evolution of our merchant and consumer payment platforms. Following major successes in expanding our core API automation coverage across our Customer Engagement ecosystem, we are scaling our Quality Engineering organization to drive next-generation Consumer Mobile Application (CMA) automation, Web/UI CI/CD test suites, and dedicated point-of-sale device testing. As an SDET, you will be a hands-on technical contributor shaping our test automation architecture. You will focus on shifting testing left, building resilient mobile and hardware test beds, streamlining CI/CD release pipelines, and automating complex end-to-end user journeys across millions of live merchant devices and consumer applications.

 What You Will Do
 Automation Strategy & Scaling: Design, configure, and scale automated testing frameworks across native mobile apps (iOS/Android), Web interfaces, and physical point-of-sale device hardware.
 Mobile & Device Testing: Develop and maintain robust UI and functional test suites for Consumer Mobile Applications and embedded terminal devices to increase release velocity and reliability.
 API & Contract Validation: Expand automated REST API test suites and mock services integrated directly into continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
 Agile Integration & Shift-Left: Collaborate closely with Product Owners and Software Engineers to review user stories, define acceptance criteria early, and embed automated test coverage into sprint deliverables.
 Defect Triage & Observability: Debug complex platform issues using systematic test design, perform root-cause analysis (RCA) on test failures, and track quality metrics using Jira and Confluence.
 AI-Assisted Engineering: Utilize modern AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Gemini) to accelerate test script development, refactor framework code, and generate synthetic test data.
 Quality Advocacy: Serve as a champion for the merchant and consumer experience, providing technical feedback to refine product design and UX workflows.
 
 What You Will Need to Have
 Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Software QA Engineering, Automation Engineering, or Software Development.
 Programming & Scripting: 2+ years of hands-on programming experience in Java, TypeScript, or Python.
 Automation Mastery: 2+ years of dedicated experience building, maintaining, and executing automated test frameworks (UI and API).
 API & Database Skills: Proven expertise testing REST APIs (Postman, HTTP, JSON) and writing SQL queries for data verification.
 Full-Stack Application Testing: Practical experience testing across all application layers—front-end UI, service/API layer, and back-end databases.
 Tooling: Proficiency with defect tracking and test management systems such as Jira, Confluence, ALM, or MTM.
 
 Experience That Would Be Great to Have
 Mobile Test Automation: Direct hands-on experience with Appium for mobile automation across iOS and Android platforms.
 Modern Web Automation: Experience using Cypress or Playwright for end-to-end (E2E) web application and UI testing.
 API Frameworks: Familiarity with Karate Framework for API automation, mock services, and contract validation.
 AI-Assisted Coding: Active familiarity using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or Gemini) to accelerate scripting and test bed setup.
 Performance & Load Testing: Exposure to developing frameworks and scenarios for load, stress, and performance testing.
 CI/CD Integration: Ability to configure test environments and integrate automated test runs into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness).
 
 How you’ll work: 
 This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity. 
 This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment. 
 
 Sponsorship: 
 You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role. 
   
 Benefits at Fiserv: 
 Fuel Your Life program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being 
 Paid holidays and generous time away policies 
 No-cost mental health support through Employee Assistance Programs 
 Living Proof program to recognize your peers’ extra effort with points redeemable for rewards 
 Eight Employee Resource Groups to foster a collaborative culture and expand your network 
 ·Unparalleled professional growth with training, development, and internal mobility opportunities 
 Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance options available from day one 
 Retirement planning and discounted shares with the Employee Stock Purchase Plan 
 Tuition assistance and reimbursement program 
 Paid parental, caregiver, and military leave 
 #LI-SH2
 
 
 Salary Range 
$140,000.00 - $210,000.00 
 
 These pay ranges apply to employees in Sunnyvale, California. Pay ranges for employees in other states may differ. 
 
 It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran. 
 
 
 
For incentive eligible associates, the successful candidate is eligible for an annual incentive opportunity which may be delivered as a mix of cash bonus and equity awards in the Company’s sole discretion. 
 
 Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv.  Please: 
 
 Apply using your legal name 
 Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). 
 
 
 Our commitment to Equal Opportunity: 
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. 
 
 If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation in completing a job application or otherwise participating in the overall hiring process, please contact  AskHR.US@fiserv.com . Please note our AskHR representatives do not have visibility to your application status. Current associates who require a workplace accommodation should refer to Fiserv’s Disability Accommodation Policy for additional information.
 
 Note to agencies: 
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
 
 Warning about fake job posts: 
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.
